breakdown.description: The prompt sets the free-end rotation to zero, even though a cantilever’s free end is generally free to rotate under an end point load.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly allows the free end to rotate, using the standard cantilever formula θ(L) = PL²/(2EI), which yields a non-zero slope of 0.0036 rad. It does not set the free-end rotation to zero as the incomplete prompt incorrectly instructed.

breakdown.description: The prompt treats the bending moment as constant and equal to P L over the entire span, even though the cantilever moment varies linearly from the free end to the fixed end.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification uses the correct deflection formula δ(L) = PL³/(3EI), which is derived from the linearly varying bending moment distribution M(x) = P(L-x). It does not treat the moment as a constant PL over the full span as the incomplete prompt incorrectly stated.
